abstract: Tracks continuous condition monitoring telemetry and measurement interval compliance
system_message:
You are the Environmental systems specialist (EMS), responsible for tracking continuous condition monitoring telemetry and measurement interval compliance across candidate archive relocation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Sensor recalibration（CALIB）
information_points.content:
EMS-CALIB-SOL：Regarding the Highland Deep Granite Repository Plan, laboratory calibration logs record a sensor recalibration drift margin of 0.05% for transit hygrometer and temperature sensor clusters after 100 operating hours.
EMS-CALIB-67I：Regarding the Plateau Subterranean Vault Plan, laboratory calibration logs establish a sensor recalibration drift margin of 0.12% across transit hygrometer and temperature sensor clusters after 100 operating hours.
EMS-CALIB-YS4：Regarding the Valley Salt Cavern Archive Plan, laboratory calibration logs indicate a sensor recalibration drift margin of 0.25% across transit hygrometer and temperature sensor clusters after 100 operating hours.

information_points.title: Tracks continuous condition monitoring telemetry and measurement interval compliance（ENV）
information_points.content:
EMS-ENV-R3D：For the Plateau Subterranean Vault Plan, active continuous environmental telemetry is true across all transit container data transmitters, and the maximum telemetry reporting interval is 5 min for temperature and relative humidity streams.
EMS-ENV-HN5：For the Highland Deep Granite Repository Plan, active continuous environmental telemetry is true across all transit container data transmitters, and the maximum telemetry reporting interval is 15 min for temperature and relative humidity transmitter streams.
EMS-ENV-J8F：Under the Valley Salt Cavern Archive Plan, active continuous environmental telemetry is confirmed as true for all transit container data transmitters, with a maximum telemetry reporting interval of 25 min across automated temperature and relative humidity streams.
